title: Billboard Graphic
text:
library(tidyverse)


data(billboard, package = "tidyr")

billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    names_prefix = "wk",
    names_transform = list(week = as.integer),
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  )

top_songs <- billboard_long |>
  count(artist, track, name = "weeks_on_chart") |>
  slice_max(weeks_on_chart, n = 12, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  mutate(song = paste(track, artist, sep = " - "))

billboard_long |>
  inner_join(top_songs, by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  ggplot(aes(week, rank, group = song)) +
  geom_line(color = "#39d5c5", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "#f4c95d", size = 1.5) +
  facet_wrap(vars(song), ncol = 4) +
  scale_y_reverse(breaks = c(1, 25, 50, 75, 100)) +
  labs(
    title = "The long runners",
    subtitle = "Weekly Billboard rank for the 12 songs charting the most weeks",
    x = "Week on the chart",
    y = "Billboard rank (1 = highest)",
    caption = "Each panel follows one song; gaps after its final chart week are not shown."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#17212b", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#17212b", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#ffffff", face = "bold", size = 8),
    text = element_text(color = "#e8eef2"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#c5d0d8"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20, color = "#ffffff"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#39d5c5"),
    plot.caption = element_text(color = "#c5d0d8")
  )
